diagnosis: The loan collateral evaluation endpoint fails to verify that the requesting broker or user is the assigned loan officer for application_id before triggering appraisal. When LTV verification fails, the custom exception handler dumps the applicant's private financial profile (verified liquid assets, annual income, credit score) directly in the 422 error body.
